meta.message: A 96x128, 14-frame one-shot: a dark crimson mist bursts from the centre with a few red sparks, then thins away, while a faint pale soul wisp rises upward with a short fading trail. It's side-on with no ground ring. The mist fades out around frame 13. Try the mist's opacity or the burst count to make it denser or lighter.
